Event: First iron ore smelted in SA
Notes: Early attempts to smelt iron ore near Rustenburg; small-scale
Source: Wikipedia - Mining industry of South Africa

Notes: Major deposits found in Limpopo; later developed for steel industry
Iron and Steel Corporation (ISCOR) founded to reduce steel import dependency
ISCOR develops Thabazimbi iron ore deposit for domestic steel production
Major iron ore deposit discovered in Northern Cape near Kathu
ISCOR develops Sishen open-pit mine; becomes SA's largest iron ore mine
Railway and port development for Sishen ore export
861km heavy-haul railway; starts operations to Saldanha Bay port
First iron ore shipment leaves Saldanha; capacity ~18 million tonnes/yr
ISCOR struggles with inefficiency; privatization debate begins
Post-sanctions era opens export markets; production increases
Source: Wikipedia - Mining industry of South Africa

Event: ISCOR privatized; sold to Kumba Resources
Notes: ISCOR sold for R4.7 billion; renamed Kumba Resources
Kumba expands Sishen and Kolomela; Anglo American majority owner
Commodity super-cycle pushes iron ore prices from ~$30 to ~$200/tonne
Kolomela (formerly Sishen South) begins production; extends mine life

Event: SA iron ore production ~67 million tonnes
Notes: Production peaks; SA is 5th-6th largest global producer
Price collapses from ~$130 to ~$40/tonne; cost pressure on SA mines
Lower prices and rail constraints reduce output
Locomotive shortages cut capacity; Kumba warns of lost revenue

Event: SA iron ore production ~71 million tonnes
Notes: Post-COVID demand recovery drives production rebound
China imports record 1.2 billion tonnes of iron ore; SA shipments increase
Kumba recapitalizes Sishen; production highest in a decade
Kumba reports R5 billion+ in lost revenue from rail failures

Event: Kumba invests in private rail solution
Notes: Kumba explores BOOT model to bypass Transnet with private rail operator
Production stable; rail and infrastructure still key constraints
Sishen mine alone holds ~1500 Mt of reserves; decades of mining ahead
Green hydrogen-based steel could increase demand for high-grade SA iron ore
